Condition: Two privileged accounts were not evidenced as reviewed in the quarterly review.
Criteria / Expected Practice: All in-scope privileged accounts should be included in periodic review.
Root Cause: Reviewer population reconciliation was not documented.
Impact Statement: Excess privileged access could remain undetected.
Recommendation: Reconcile privileged account inventory to the review population and document completeness checks.

Condition: One sampled emergency change was retrospectively reviewed after the one-business-day target.
Criteria / Expected Practice: Emergency changes should receive timely retrospective review.
Root Cause: The reviewer queue was not monitored against the SLA.
Impact Statement: Emergency changes may remain ungoverned longer than intended.
Recommendation: Add SLA tracking and escalation for overdue emergency change reviews.

Condition: Documented restore evidence was not available for one critical system in the quarterly sample.
Criteria / Expected Practice: Critical backups should have periodic documented restoration testing.
Root Cause: Restore testing responsibilities were not mapped to all critical systems.
Impact Statement: Backup availability cannot be fully relied upon for the affected system.
Recommendation: Create a system-level restore test schedule with completion evidence and exception escalation.

Condition: One application review had approval evidence stored outside the standard evidence repository.
Criteria / Expected Practice: Review completion and approval should be retained in the designated repository.
Root Cause: Evidence retention requirements were not consistently followed.
Impact Statement: Auditability of the access review process is reduced.
Recommendation: Enforce evidence repository usage and perform quarterly completeness checks.
